name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
March 13, 2012
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Celia Taghdiri of Baha'i Faith
Recommended Action:
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION*3
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring Wednesday, February 29, 2012, "Mildred Eleanor Anderson Taylor Day" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Presentation of the following Crime and Substance Abuse Prevention Commission's
Law Enforcement Awards:
Sworn Officer of the Year - Corporal Andy Julian
Professional Staff Member of the Year - Chris Ely
Reserve Officer of the Year - Reserve Deputy Ray Tutera
P3.
Proclamation declaring Monday, March 12, 2012, "Girl Scout Day" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/SA/BSD)
C3.
National Endowment of the Arts Our Town Grant Application Letter of Endorsement (CC)
C4.
Amendment to Vista Municipal Code Section 3.52.060 (CC)
C5.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CC)
C6.
Approval of Access to State, Local, and Federal Criminal History (CC)
C7.
FY 2010 and FY 2011 Urban Area Security Initiative Program Grant (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , accepting grant funds of $139,000 in FY 2010 Urban Area Security Initiative Program funding and grant funds of $431,430 in FY 2011 Urban Area Security Initiative Program funding, and amending the Fiscal Year 2011/12 Operating Budget.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the FY 2011 Memorandum of Understanding/Grant Assurances for FY 2011 Urban Area Security Initiative Program Grant.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the agreement with Lynx Technologies for San Diego Regional Public Safety GIS Services.
C8.
Abandoned Vehicle Abatement Program Extension (CC)
C9.
Initial Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule (SA)
C10.
Calvary Chapel of Vista Special Event Banner (CC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
General Plan 2030 Update (CC)
1.
Conduct a Public Hearing to receive public testimony regarding the General Plan 2030 Update, close the Public Hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , certifying the Final Program Environmental Impact Report prepared for the General Plan 2030 Update, adopting Environmental Findings and a Statement of Overriding Considerations pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act, and adopting a Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , adopting the General Plan 2030 Update.
4.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2012- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, adopting Zoning Map No. 5; amending various chapters of Title 18; adding Chapter 18.15 creating a Biological Preserve Overlay Zone; adding Chapter 18.35 creating a Mixed Use Zone; amending the Downtown Specific Plan, Townsite Specific Plan, and Specific Plan No. 14; and repealing Specific Plan Nos. 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 12, 16, 18, 21, 22, 29, 31, 32, 33, and the Vista Gateway Specific Plan. "
PH2.
Nuisance Abatement Hearing - 1558 Manor Drive (CC)
1.
Conduct a Public Hearing regarding the condition of the property located at 1558 Manor Drive, close the Public Hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , declaring that the condition of the property at 1558 Manor Drive, Vista, California constitutes a public nuisance and authorizing the City Manager to abate the public nuisance if the property owners fail to abate the nuisance within thirty days.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
